title: Fix build and test failures
body:
Build failed on `@object-ui/console` (1 TS error) and 5 test files had assertion mismatches against actual component behavior.

### Build fix
- Remove unused `vi` import in `console-load-performance.test.tsx` — violated `noUnusedLocals: true`

### Test data format mismatches
- `ObjectTimeline.test.tsx`, `ViewSwitching.test.tsx` — mock `find()` returned `{ value: data }` but `ObjectTimeline` only extracts from plain arrays, `{ records }`, or `{ data }`

```diff
- mockDataSource.find.mockResolvedValue({ value: mockData });
+ mockDataSource.find.mockResolvedValue(mockData);
```

### Missing side-effect imports
- `BrowserSimulation.test.tsx` — asserted `ComponentRegistry.get('dashboard')` and `get('report')` without importing the plugins that register them

### Assertion/component mismatches
- `ObjectView.test.tsx` — expected translated `'Object Not Found'` but no `I18nProvider` wraps the test; changed to match raw key `'console.objectView.objectNotFound'`
- `ObjectGalleryIntegration.test.tsx` — asserted subtitle field text but `ObjectGallery` only renders `titleField` + `visibleFields`, not `subtitleField`
